cta_title: READY TO TURN RESEARCH TRAFFIC INTO PIPELINE?
findings: Brand migration is leaking paid efficiency. amplussolar.com is still indexed and linked from partners, then soft-redirects every visit to gentari.in (verified 14 Sep 2026) - splitting domain authority, breaking retargeting continuity and confusing procurement teams who were pitched 'Amplus'. Consolidate 301 mapping, tracking and all ad URLs.

The only CTA is a 7-field 'contact us' form. Name, Email, Phone, Company, Message, source and Location before any value is delivered - with no savings/ROI estimator, no 'talk to an engineer' scheduler and no case-study download. Enterprise forms with 5+ fields convert 40-60% worse than staged capture.

650+ projects of proof, almost none of it gated. Client logos and MW numbers exist on the site, but there is no downloadable vertical case study (auto, pharma, textiles), no savings-report lead magnet and no plant walkthrough video - so anonymous research traffic from CFOs and plant heads leaves no trace.

No always-on capture on high-intent search. Category terms ('rooftop solar for industry', 'open access solar power', 'solar PPA India') are where enterprise buyers start; without dedicated landing pages per solution (on-site, off-site, BESS, I-RECs, hydrogen), that intent flows to aggregators and competitors.

LinkedIn is organic-only; the ABM layer is missing. The enquiry form's own 'How did you hear about us?' (LinkedIn, Events, News) proves social and field matter - but there is no target-account engine: no CFO / plant-head / ESG-head persona tracks, no site-behavior retargeting feeding the form.
headline: We Found 3 Leaks Costing You Enterprise Pipeline

outreach: Subject A (Audit): Amplus -> Gentari - 3 funnel leaks losing enterprise enquiries (verified 14 Sep)

2. The only conversion path is a 7-field contact form - no savings estimator, case-study gate or scheduler for CFOs and plant heads.
3. No always-on demand engine - organic + thought-leadership only, while C&I rivals run LinkedIn ABM + high-intent search.

I have a 2-page confidential audit with the fix for each. Want me to send it on WhatsApp or email?

ad_intro:
Amplus Solar (amplussolar.com) is India's C&I rooftop-solar pioneer - founded 2008 in Gurugram, now 2.3+ GWp across 650+ projects in 25 states for 400+ enterprise clients, and since 5 May 2025 officially rebranded into Gentari (the PETRONAS clean-energy arm; 7.5 GW India portfolio). This is enterprise infrastructure sold on 15-25 year PPAs - not residential subsidy product.

Three leaks stand out (verified 14 Sep 2026): (1) the Amplus-to-Gentari migration splits the funnel - amplussolar.com is still indexed and linked, then soft-redirects to gentari.in, leaking attribution, retargeting pools and buyer trust; (2) the only conversion path is a 7-field enterprise enquiry form with no savings estimator, no case-study gate and no meeting scheduler; (3) there is no always-on paid demand engine - thought-leadership and organic social only - while C&I rivals run LinkedIn ABM and capture high-intent search.

Company facts verified from amplussolar.com, gentari.in and press on 14 Sep 2026. Meta count verified at zero on 14 Sep 2026 (India, active filter, keyword search) - LinkedIn + Search carry this P&L, not Meta.
